title: Backend Developer
description:
Backend Developer

**Company:** AppNexus Technology Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** B114 First floor Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years

About the Role

AppNexus Technology Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled **Backend Developer** to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable backend applications and APIs for web and mobile platforms.

You will work on projects across **FinTech, Digital Banking, ERP, Healthcare, Education, E\-commerce, Logistics, and other business applications**, AI \& Cloud who can develop scalable collaborating with frontend, mobile, UI/UX, and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain robust backend applications using cloud Ai and Chatgpt **PHP and Laravel**.
* Build secure and scalable **REST APIs** for web and mobile applications.
* Design and manage databases using **MySQL/PostgreSQL**.
* Implement authentication, authorization, **RBAC**, and API security.
* Integrate third\-party services, payment gateways, SMS, email, OTP, maps, and other APIs.
* Develop business logic, database structures, and backend workflows.
* Optimize application performance, database queries, and API response times.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve backend issues.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Work with Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Coordinate with frontend and Flutter developers for API integration.
* Deploy and maintain applications on **Linux/AWS/VPS/CloudPanel** environments.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and production releases.
* Understand project requirements and convert them into technical solutions.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **phyton and**  **Laravel**.
* Good understanding of **MySQL/PostgreSQL**.
* Experience in developing **RESTful APIs**.
* Strong understanding of MVC architecture and OOP concepts.
* Knowledge of authentication methods such as JWT/OAuth/token\-based authentication.
* Experience with Git/GitHub.
* Good understanding of database design, relationships, indexing, and query optimization.
* Basic knowledge of Linux server environments and deployment.
* Understanding of JSON, API integrations, and third\-party services.
* Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems independently.

Good to Have

* Experience with **Redis, queues, cron jobs, and caching**.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Experience integrating payment gateways and financial APIs.
* Knowledge of Docker.
* Experience with Flutter/mobile application backend integration.
* Experience working on FinTech, ERP, e\-commerce, or SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of microservices or multi\-tenant architecture.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong programming and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.
* Candidates who can independently handle backend modules and API development are preferred.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Company Description **About Sopra Steria**  

Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.  

**The world is how we shape it.**

  

Job Description  

Position : AS400 Developer


Experience: 4 to 6 years


Location: Noida, BLR ( Prefer Noida)


Education: B.E./ B.Tech. / MCA


Primary Skills : AS400, OS400, Cobol, CL, DB2

* 4\-6 years of AS400 Development environment with strong COBOL, CL, and DB2 skills.
* Previous experience working with financial application involving Loan/Credit Card/Mortgage/Retail Banking is preferable.
* Experienced in providing Support and Maintenance on existing CL/SQLCBL/RPGLE/RPG400/SQLRPGLE based applications.
* Good RPG development skills in RPG, RPG III, RPGLE, Embedded SQL and Free Format RPGLE.
* Strong knowledge of OS 400 operating systems and CL job control language and job scheduler.
* Strong knowledge in DB2 and Cobol DB2 programming
* Participate in Design and Development of new features in the product.
* Knowledge in Agile working methodology.
* Mentoring of Junior Team members

* Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
